A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LogicXGNN and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–F. Corresponding content can be reliably matched despite pagination and naming changes.

before.justification: v3 reports original fidelity, runtime, scalability, and explanation-quality experiments in Tables 1–4 and Appendix C, plus generated explanation examples.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and additionally reports complete synthetic-rule recovery at depth 10 in Section 4.2.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 adds a node-classification adaptation that forms class-wise rules by OR-combining node predicates and bypassing the graph-level activation matrix. The existing graph-classification procedure remains unchanged.

E1.justification: Dataset and evaluated task coverage are retained, including the continuous-feature example in Appendix D.3. Appendix A already identifies BAMultiShapes as BAShapes, so revised labels do not indicate a new dataset. The node-classification adaptation has no reported evaluation.

E2.justification: GLGExplainer and GraphTrail remain the evaluated comparators throughout the corresponding experiments. The new GCNeuron footnote explains its exclusion; it does not add or remove an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Appendices B and E retain the splits, GNN architectures, training budgets, metrics, timeouts, and explanation-complexity controls. The synthetic recovery discussion concerns depths already covered by the existing depth study and specifies no revised experimental settings.

E4.justification: v3 provides synthetic rule examples in Appendix E.3. v4 adds a focused analysis in Section 4.2 comparing learned clauses with the generating motif logic and discussing recovery at depths 5 and 10. Existing sensitivity and explanation-quality analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the three-seed reporting policy, its application to GNN training, the same uncertainty reporting, and the per-seed records in Table 7. No additional statistical procedure or increased run count is reported.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 newly reports complete recovery of the BAMultiShapes rule at depth 10, although the corresponding complete rule is not displayed. Existing numerical tables, plotted results, and Appendix E.3 rule examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: New Appendix B.5 derives grounding-tree training cost as O(|V|² log|V|), using constant feature dimension and bounds on examples and predicates. v3 only gives the simplified O(|V|²) discussion, which v4 also retains. The orbit-ordering theorem and proof are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and main conclusion retain the same grounding contribution, fidelity metric, over-20% average improvement claim, and 10–100× speedup claim. The added biochemical future-work direction does not redefine the claimed contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 newly interprets existing synthetic predicates as House, Wheel, and Grid combinations, giving semantic meaning to the displayed clauses. The added main-text explanation of baseline grounding failures largely repeats material already present in Appendix B.4.

D1.justification: Appendix B.5 newly characterizes grounding trees as intentionally shallow and their feature dimension as a small constant. This adds implementation characterization without establishing a changed implementation. Hardware, concrete training settings, and code access remain equivalent.

R1.justification: A new footnote distinguishes GCNeuron's neuron-concept importance scores from explicit class-wise decision rules, clarifying the comparison scope. The reference list and Related Work section otherwise retain the same works and positioning.

P1.justification: v4 adds localized explanatory passages, Appendix B.5, acknowledgments, and updated author information while retaining most prose and section organization. Two Appendix E.1 references that correctly pointed to Table 1 in v3 become 'Table ??'.

P2.justification: The figures and tables are retained, with unchanged figure graphics. v4 changes the author/header layout, float placement, selected BAShapes labels, and captions; Table 13 moves to the following page. Table 2's revised caption omits the previously stated runtime units.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves technical clarity by explaining node-level rule construction, making tree-training cost assumptions explicit in Appendix B.5, and interpreting the synthetic motif rules. The empirical evidence remains largely unchanged. Gains are limited by the undisplayed depth-10 rule, retention of the simplified main-text complexity bound, two broken table references, and omission of Table 2's runtime units.
